'''Primal Torntusk''' is a level 60 [[elite]] [[quest giver]] located in [[Revantusk Village]] in the [[contested]] territory of the [[Hinterlands]]. She is also a [[primal]] and the leader of the [[Revantusk tribe]], the last remaining tribe of [[forest trolls]] in [[Thrall]]'s [[Horde]].

She starts the following quests:
* {{questlong|Horde|50|Dark Vessels}}
* {{questlong|Horde|51|Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!}}

See [[List of the Hinterlands NPCs]].
